changes.before: The rock underfoot in the Dolomites is sharper than most trails your dog knows. Pads that cope fine at home can wear through in a single day.
changes.after: Rock on rugged trails can be sharper than the surfaces your dog knows. Pads that cope fine at home can wear through in a single day.
changes.reason: Removes the geographic reference while retaining the warning about sharp terrain.

changes.before: Limestone in the Dolomites is often sharp-edged rather than smooth and worn, and scree fields concentrate a lot of small, unstable, abrasive rock underfoot. Pads that are fine on forest trails at home can wear down faster than you'd expect over a full day on this kind of surface.
changes.after: Limestone can be sharp-edged rather than smooth and worn, and scree fields concentrate a lot of small, unstable, abrasive rock underfoot. Pads that are fine on forest trails at home can wear down faster than you'd expect over a full day on this kind of surface.
